meta.source: Figma file Rocket-Wave (j35T99mHfGON7KM8fKamjK): Logo, Typography and Dashboard frames, adapted for product UI on 2026-11-08

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Rocket orange, exact from the logo SVG. Brand moments, active nav marker, progress, icons, large text 24px+. Not for small text on white (3.2:1).

tokens.name: brand-strong
tokens.usage: Orange for small text and links on surface or canvas (5.0:1 on white). Use instead of brand whenever text is under 24px.

tokens.name: brand-tint
tokens.usage: Soft orange ground for the selected nav item, highlighted plan card and brand callouts.

tokens.name: flame
tokens.usage: The small flame triangle under the rocket, exact from the logo SVG. Accent only: illustrations, the cover, celebratory moments. Never text.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and the primary button fill (the current app's black buttons, kept).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels, helper text. Replaces the old #9F9F9F, which failed contrast (2.6:1).

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Placeholder text and disabled labels only, never for real data (3.4:1, below body-text contrast by design).

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an ink-filled button or badge.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: App background behind cards (matches the current dashboard grey).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sidebar, dialogs, header.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Input fields and read-only value wells (the current field grey).

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state on rows, nav items and ghost buttons.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Card and table dividers, hairlines.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input and checkbox borders, secondary button outline (3:1 against surface).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring with a 2px offset on every interactive element.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Text and icon for Active, Paid, Filed, Verified (4.7:1 on success-tint). Replaces #50CD89, which failed contrast.

tokens.name: success-tint
tokens.usage: Badge ground for success states.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Text and icon for Upcoming, Due soon, Waiting on customer.

tokens.name: warning-tint
tokens.usage: Badge ground for warning states.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Text and icon for Overdue, Failed, Rejected, destructive buttons.

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Badge ground for danger states and error field backgrounds.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Text and icon for In progress, Filed with authority, informational notes.

tokens.name: info-tint
tokens.usage: Badge ground for info states.

tokens.name: neutral-tint
tokens.usage: Badge ground for Draft, Inactive, Not applicable (text uses ink-muted).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label gap, badge padding block.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside a control, between stacked label and field.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button padding inline (small), list row gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Field padding, mobile page gutter, gap between form fields.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop, gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section spacing inside a page.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page top spacing, empty-state padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, checkboxes, tags (was 5px).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, read-only wells, menu items (kept from the current fields).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, dialogs, sheets (was 15px, now on the 4px grid).

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Buttons and the company switcher (the current pill buttons, kept).

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Cards on canvas in light theme; replaced by the border token in dark theme.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs, popovers, the support chat panel.
